rationale: The agent cancelled the order without first confirming the action with the user, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing write. The user initially wanted to cancel specific items and only cancel the whole order if partial cancellation wasn’t possible; the agent did not check or communicate about partial cancellation feasibility before acting. Additionally, the message states the refund will go to the user’s PayPal account without any tool evidence shown to support that detail, making it an unsupported claim. While the agent appeared to look up user and order details, the lack of explicit confirmation and the unsupported refund detail mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
